acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.milestoneIndex: The milestone that receives the additional funds.

cancelJob(uint256).details: Implements tiered penalty system to prevent abuse:      - Cancellations 0-2: 0% penalty (free)      - Cancellations 3-5: 5% penalty      - Cancellations 6-10: 10% penalty      - Cancellations 11+: 15% penalty      Additional penalty based on number of applications received

createEscrow(address,address,uint256,uin.details: Deposit = totalAmount + platformFee. Fee is separated immediately.

extendDeadline(uint256,uint256).details: Only the depositor can extend. Extension must be at least 1 day.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.reason: Admin's reason for the resolution decision (required)

submitRating(uint256,uint8,string).details: Each participant may rate the other exactly once per escrow.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

addJobFunds(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Add more funds to an open job (before freelancer is assigned)         and allocate them to a specific milestone so the sum invariant         (sum(milestoneAmounts) == totalAmount) is always maintained.

approveMilestoneProposal(uint256,uint256.notice: Client approves the proposed milestone changes

cancelJob(uint256).notice: Cancel an open job and refund the depositor (only if no freelancer assigned)

extendDeadline(uint256,uint256).notice: Extend the deadline of an active escrow.

getAverageRating(address).notice: Returns average rating (scaled ×100) and count for an address.         e.g. average = 450 means 4.50 stars.

getRating(uint256,address).notice: Returns the rating a specific rater gave in an escrow (0 if not rated).

getRatingsForAddress(address).notice: Returns all ratings received by an address.

proposeMilestoneChange(uint256,uint256,u.notice: Freelancer proposes changes to a milestone

quoteDeposit(uint256).notice: Compute the total deposit required (totalAmount + fee).

rejectMilestoneProposal(uint256,uint256).notice: Client rejects the proposed milestone changes

submitRating(uint256,uint8,string).notice: Submit a 1-5 star rating after the escrow is fully released.

withdrawJobFunds(uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: Withdraw funds from a specific milestone on an open job         (before freelancer is assigned). Reduces both totalAmount and         the chosen milestone's amount to keep the sum invariant.
